intro.name: Visalan H
intro.title: Full Stack Developer
intro.bio: web apps that help people and make dev work slightly less painful.

sectionDescriptions.projects: I build web stuff in the hope that it makes someone's life slightly less annoying. Here are some projects.
sectionDescriptions.college: Every project here started with someone complaining in a corridor. Usually me.
sectionDescriptions.extensions: Browser helpers that promise one feature and deliver three new buttons you don't need.
sectionDescriptions.npm-packages: I occasionally throw code at NPM that approximately 7 people find useful. Here's some stuff I've made.
sectionDescriptions.experience: I haven't worked anywhere officially yet, but my GitHub isn't empty. Looking for someone to fix that first part. Interested?
sectionDescriptions.education: Currently sitting through engineering classes while learning way more from side projects.

college.title: Trackify
college.complaint: Students have to calculate their CGPA and credits by hand
college.description: Credits, electives and CGPA were spread across mark sheets and guesswork. Upload your grade PDF and see exactly where you stand.

college.title: Quick QB
college.complaint: Question banks are scattered and hard to find
college.description: Students upload and download question banks and answer keys for 500+ course codes. Search by subject code or name.

college.title: Idlee
college.complaint: Finding an empty classroom means scanning door QR codes
college.description: The portal shows a room's timetable only if you scan the QR code on its door. Idlee reads it for you, lists the nearest free rooms, and lets students report which ones are locked.

college.title: Polaris
college.complaint: Students can't see where the college bus is
college.description: Drivers share their location from a Flutter app, and students on the transport list watch every bus move on a live map.

college.title: Tech Society Platform
college.complaint: Club applications are hard to review and approve
college.description: Members apply through one form, and admins approve or reject them by community. Roles decide who can do what.

college.title: Munch
college.complaint: Checking vending machine stock means walking to each one
college.description: Every machine has its own QR sticker. Munch puts them all behind one link, sorted by floor.

college.title: JustResults
college.complaint: The results portal slows down on results day
college.description: The results page loads far more than it needs, so it struggles when everyone checks at once. This extension blocks the CSS, images and scripts, cutting load time from 959 ms to 352 ms.

projects.title: Vizzible
projects.complaint: Coding profiles are split across three sites
projects.description: Your GitHub, Codeforces and LeetCode activity on one page and one link, ready for your bio or resume.

projects.title: GitRid
projects.complaint: GitHub only deletes repos one at a time
projects.description: Pick up to 50 repos and delete them or change their visibility in one go, with a confirm step before anything happens.

projects.title: Echo
projects.complaint: Job applications are hard to keep track of
projects.description: Echo reads your job emails with read-only Gmail access, pulls out the company, role and stage, and builds your timeline for you.

extensions.title: CodeFocus
extensions.complaint: Solving on Codeforces means switching to another editor
extensions.description: Adds a split-view editor to Codeforces problems, with a sample runner, one-click submit and a sketchpad for each problem.

extensions.title: Audio Focus
extensions.complaint: Background tabs play over the one you're using
extensions.description: Mutes or lowers every background tab so the one you're using stays at full volume. Mute mode silences them, and Duck mode sets their volume with a slider.

extensions.title: LeetCode CMD+K
extensions.complaint: Retyping the same snippets on every LeetCode problem
extensions.description: A keyboard-first command palette for LeetCode. Search Java and C++ snippets and insert them into the editor.

extensionsArchive.title: Leetcode-Fahh
extensionsArchive.description: Plays FAHH every time you fail a LeetCode test case. Works on both Run and Submit.

archive.title: Tagdex
archive.description: Every HTML element laid out like the periodic table. Click a tile to open a specimen card with a live demo of that element.

archive.title: Shadey
archive.description: Draw words, stickers or pixel art on your GitHub contribution graph and paint it for real. It calculates each shade against your busiest days so the result matches the preview.

archive.title: Bloom
archive.description: Full-screen hydration reminders with a living flower. It wilts if you skip water and thrives when you drink.

archive.title: FLAMES
archive.description: The FLAMES calculator you played on paper in school, now on the internet.

archive.title: npx-resume-new
archive.description: Share your resume through the terminal with colors and clickable links.

archive.title: Checksite
archive.description: URL uptime monitor that pings your sites every 10 minutes and sends email alerts when they go down or recover.

archive.title: Vizzkers
archive.description: A social platform for cat lovers to share and celebrate their feline friends.

archive.title: VizzPen
archive.description: A CodePen-inspired web application built in just 7 days using the MERN stack.

archive.title: Resume Roast
archive.description: AI-powered resume critique tool that provides harsh but constructive feedback.

archive.title: VizzTrack
archive.description: A full-stack MERN job application tracker to organize your job search.

archive.title: Image Slider
archive.description: A simple, clean image carousel/slider component.

archive.title: VizzCheck
archive.description: Check PDFs for QR codes and extract links from them.

items.name: vizzy-search
items.description: Implements fuzzy search using Levenshtein distance.
